optimizedDescription.value: One graph indexes many workspaces with canonical identities, repository-backed specs, and exact cross-workspace package resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules
- File/Document identity: `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}`; project-global outside workspace roots: `root:{projectRelativePath}`. Workspace ownership wins; never duplicate physical file as `root:`.
- `path` is canonical identity for symbols, IDs, relations. Store forward-slash `projectRelativePath` relative to active-config project root, no leading `./`, allowing `..`; denormalize onto symbols for lookup/navigation.
- Strings matching `^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]` or `^[A-Za-z]:$` are drive paths, never workspace prefixes. Applies to exclusion, hotspots, SQLite filters, package surfaces, CLI display.
- `SymbolNode.id = {filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}`.
- `SpecNode.workspace` stores workspace; spec IDs remain `{workspace}:{specPath}`, respecting configured prefix.
- Discover from absolute workspace `codeRoot`; `discoverFiles` returns root-relative paths and remains workspace-agnostic; indexer prefixes identity and derives project-relative path.
- Exact file selectors normalize canonical, project-relative, absolute spellings to one file. Wildcards retain pattern semantics.
- Specs come only from workspace `SpecRepository`: `list()`, `persistedStateHash()`, artifacts via `artifact()` (`spec.md` first, remaining alphabetical; exclude metadata/locks), `metadata()` defaults, `readPersistedDependsOn()`, `readPersistedImplementation()`. No CLI precompute or filesystem fallback.
- Pass 2 starts after symbols and public bindings for all workspaces are final. Relative imports stay workspace-local.
- Package imports use adapter `packageResolution` facts mapping package→workspace and resolve names only through target package published entry surfaces/public bindings; never search target workspace symbols. Resolved named import records binding target, resolution step, entry-file `IMPORTS`; unnamed import records entry-file `IMPORTS`. Downstream `USES_TYPE`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS` use binding.
- Unresolved package imports create no relation/binding/step; diagnostics remain non-persisted. Undeclared packages count external only.
- Tests are never package entries; import qualified-name lookup cannot target test symbols.
- Qualified symbol identities resolve globally by exact qualified name; file-qualified identities resolve through importing adapter `qualifiedNameResolution` and `packageResolution`.
- Cross-workspace identity is structured workspace/module-package/public-surface/symbol-space. Apply language case, visibility, supported config. Never infer from global or workspace same-name uniqueness.
- Workspace roots, package identity, `exports`/`main`, module paths, project references, autoload mappings, and adapter `resolutionManifests()` affect derivation fingerprint.
- `IndexOptions`: project root, `ProjectWorkspace[]`, `ProjectGraphConfig`, optional progress/chunk/ref, explicit `vcsRoot: string|null`. Graph config carries global includes/excludes and per-workspace allowed/excluded paths/`respectGitignore`. Removed `WorkspaceIndexTarget.specs`.
- `IndexResult.workspaces` reports per-workspace discovered/indexed/skipped/removed files and discovered/indexed specs.
- `respectGitignore` defaults true: non-null `vcsRoot` loads root+nested files relative to location; gitignore exclusions have priority. Null root forbids VCS probing. False applies only explicit exclusions.

## Constraints
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`.
- One project graph store.
- Discovery workspace-agnostic; indexer owns identities/project-relative paths.
- Spec access only through `SpecRepository`.
- Identity metadata changes require full rebuild.
